correctness.rationale: There are exactly two nondegenerate alternating n-simplices for each n>=1. Their lengths and normalized integral boundaries are computed explicitly; even boundaries are primitive sums of the two preceding odd generators and odd boundaries are primitive differences of the two preceding even generators. Attaching the first cell in each dimension along a unit-degree sphere map kills the preceding sphere, while the second births the next sphere, including n=1 and n=2 cases. Integral homology and maps thereby give the claimed all-dimensional half-open barcode with no torsion. All finite bars have length a, so matching them to the diagonal gives degreewise bottleneck-to-point distance at most a/2, attained in reduced H0. An independent enumeration-and-F2-reduction script checked 68 positive rational/integer cost pairs through homology degree 10; this finite check is not the all-degree proof.

value.rationale: Natural minimal non-reversible quasi-metric model. An all-scale all-degree integral homotopy and barcode classification exhibits infinitely many higher spheres and sharp contractible windows that disappear when a=b. It distinguishes complete directional information (H0 death a and H1 birth b) from the coarse degreewise bottleneck-to-point radius a/2, which is blind to b. This is an exact benchmark for directed enriched-nerve and magnitude persistence, rather than a finite table or arbitrary slice; it does not claim broader applications already proven.
